item.title: Google Buys 400 MW Geothermal from Fervo for Utah Hub
item.description: Google’s new 400 MW geothermal PPA with Fervo powers a Utah AI data center, showcasing enhanced geothermal tech and advancing its 2030 net‑zero goal.
